prompt: Show the account-opening funnel by step and channel for the last 30 days, including completion and abandonment rates.

results.text:
Session-to-application completion is **68.52%** across both channels: **378** sessions started and **259** applications were submitted. Only seven logical days of history exist (2026-07-18 to 2026-07-25), so that is the period shown rather than 30 days.

- mobile_app: **224** sessions, **155** applications (**69.20%** completion, **30.80%** abandonment), **24** referred to manual review, **120** opened.
- web: **154** sessions, **104** applications (**67.53%** completion, **32.47%** abandonment), **18** referred, **78** opened.

The two channels convert within two points of each other, so neither stands out.

sql.command:
SELECT channel, SUM(sessions_started) AS sessions_started, SUM(applications_submitted) AS applications_submitted, SUM(referred_to_review) AS referred_to_review, SUM(applications_approved) AS applications_approved, SUM(applications_submitted) / SUM(sessions_started) AS completion_rate
FROM aa_digital_funnel
WHERE session_date > DATE_SUB((SELECT logical_time FROM demo_active_run WHERE singleton_id = 1), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY channel
